ci: CI run 41036163886 at code head 377d5a49: changes succeeded and selected dispatch_two_builds. Every other job, including the required lint, typecheck and test and dispatch-two-builds, was still queued on GitHub at 10:37Z. I did not wait for them, and none had settled red.
notes: main's effective rules (ruleset 12331919) require lint, typecheck, test and pr-title, not ci-ok. So a red dispatch-two-builds fails ci-ok but does not by itself stop a merge until a person changes the ruleset to require ci-ok. That is tracked on dispatch://INFRA-430 and dispatch://INFRA-490, and this pull request cannot make it.

Revoked socket: in one earlier attempt, run by hand before the scripted trials, the socket did not close within 40s of the newer build starting, and I could not establish why. The newer build's registration time was not captured, and its log file was overwritten. The 5 controlled runs after it all closed with 1012 within 8.2s.

Per the architect: migrations 0148-0150 share numbers with INFRA-562's #2387 (0148-0151). Whichever pull request lands second renumbers, and the deployment lane's merge test refuses a clash. This round does not fail on it.

0722ae5a's retry inside the consumer lease after a stop-cancelled context is a timing path I could not hit on real processes. The harness's message test (graceful stops of each build while it holds the intake) passed, and the intake hold tests that CI runs cover the retry.
